description: This PHP source file defines the Vtiger_Field class, which provides APIs to control and manipulate CRM fields in the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for managing picklist values, setting related modules, retrieving field instances, and deleting fields.

classes.name: Vtiger_Field
classes.description: Provides APIs to manage vtiger CRM fields, including picklist management, relation setting, and field retrieval.

methods.name: __getPicklistUniqueId
methods.description: Fetches a unique identifier for a picklist.

methods.name: setPicklistValues
methods.description: Sets values for a picklist field, creating the picklist table if it does not exist.

methods.name: setNoRolePicklistValues
methods.description: Sets picklist values for fields not role-based, creating the necessary table if needed.

methods.name: setRelatedModules
methods.description: Creates or updates relation between the field and specified modules (UIType 10).

methods.name: unsetRelatedModules
methods.description: Removes relation between the field and specified modules.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a Vtiger_Field instance by fieldid or fieldname.

methods.name: getAllForBlock
methods.description: Retrieves all field instances associated with a block.

methods.name: getAllForModule
methods.description: Retrieves all field instances associated with a given module.

methods.name: deleteForModule
methods.description: Deletes all fields associated with a specified module.
